c1.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-17 · Journey 2, setting the site
Set Location holds the map: click to place the site, or type. Latitude, longitude and elevation are needed before the site is set; the station check uses all three. Climate zone and hours from UTC are for export and may be left unset. Climate zone is the ten codes honeybee-ph's Grasshopper component allows (Not defined, 1 to 8, 4C), with no moisture letter. Hours from UTC is typed, never guessed from longitude.
Read from SketchUp Geolocation fills latitude and longitude once, and hours from UTC if SketchUp supplies one; it does not fill elevation. Nothing is written back. No address search and no lookups: the panel reaches no network. To measure on a host: what SketchUp reports for a Model with no geolocation, whether it supplies a UTC offset, and whether it exposes an elevation.

c1b.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-16 · The map
An outline map shipped with the extension: world countries, plus state and province borders for the US and Canada, from public-domain data. No web tiles; the panel's no-network rule stands. On it: pan and zoom, click a station to select it, hover for its details, and in Set Location click to place the site. The outline drawn here is a rough placeholder.

c2.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-16 · Climate sources
Separate cards, as PH-Navigator: Phius climate data and Hourly weather file. No PHI for now. In the first version Phius climate data is the only climate and the one that exports: pick a station from the folder, or type and paste the values by hand. The Hourly weather file card is shown as Planned.
Design temperatures (ASHRAE 99% heating and 1% cooling dry bulb) are typed on their own card. Export does not wait on them; only the blended heat pump does.

c3.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-15 · The per-computer setting
Each folder's location and its name are kept in PH-Composer's own settings file in the user's folder, shared by every SketchUp version; not in SketchUp's preferences and never in a Model. No list of stations is stored: the folder is read when the picker opens. You type the dataset name, prefilled from the folder's name. Reached from the Climate tab and listed in the Setup view. The first version recognises Phius station files only.
Journey 1, 2026-11-17: files stay where they are and are never copied in, so new or changed files show the next time the picker opens; Rescan is gone. Files not read are reported by kind.

c4.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-17 · Journey 3, the picker
Every recognised station file under the folder is a marker; the state is its parent folder's name. A station passes within 50 mi (80 km) and 400 ft (122 m) of the site, both required (Phius Certification Guidebook 2024, 1.4.4.2). The picker opens sorted by distance, framed on the 50 mile ring, with State set to All; Find Nearest returns to that view. It shows one dataset at a time: the one the attached station came from, else the one last used on this computer. Drawn here narrowed to one state.

c5.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-16 · What the Model keeps, and what a station lacks
A full copy of the chosen station: location, monthly values and peak loads, with the dataset name, station name and a checksum. No folder path.
A Phius station gives three peak-load cases; that is the complete set, and Cooling 2 stays empty. Ground temperatures stay empty and unflagged. Average wind speed is typed, prefilled with the mean of the file's January and July values. Values may be edited after attaching; the source is then marked as edited. Charts are not drawn.

c6.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-17 · Journey 6, another computer
The same Model opened where its source is not set: every value reads from the Model's copy, with no notice and nothing held back at export. Edit Values and Clear work on the Model's copy. Replace stays enabled and, with no climate data folder, explains and offers Choose Climate Data Folder and Enter Values by Hand.
The source is looked for by station name and state in every climate data folder on the computer, whatever the folder is called: same checksum, Source found; different, Source changed; none, Not on this computer.

c7.text:
At 420 px the source list becomes one select above the content, and tables scroll sideways. Nine tabs wrap to three rows at this width.
SETTLED 2026-11-16 · Climate is the first tab, before Zones. OPEN · which tab the panel opens on.

c3b.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-16 · Code decisions
Climate is its own feature, not a Library kind. A Model holds one site and one Phius climate, which is what exports; replacing the station is one Undo step. One built-in Phius reader now; a shared plug-in contract for formats waits until the hourly weather file gives a second example.

c8.text: Journey 2, 2026-11-17: a new Model has no site. The card reads Not set and the pane says what the site is for. Not drawn: the read button when the Model has no geolocation, which waits on a host measurement.

c9.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-17 · Journey 3
With no site, Phius climate data asks for the site first: the station check and the list's order both need it. Enter Values by Hand does not.

c10.text: Journey 3, 2026-11-17: a folder is set and nothing is attached. Choose Station opens the picker.

c11.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-17 · Journey 3, a failing station
A station outside the Phius limits can be attached with no confirm step. The picker says so before Attach; the card, the pane and the Export report then show it as outside the limits. Phius asks for a custom dataset beyond the limits and names exceptions, so PH-Composer reports and does not block.

c12.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-17 · Journey 4, entering values by hand
One grid in the order of a Phius climate file: eight series rows, twelve months, then Heating 1, Heating 2 and Cooling. One paste from a Phius workbook fills it; cells can be typed. It saves with gaps and is then marked Incomplete; export leaves the climate out, with a finding, until it is complete. Name and station elevation are needed. Latitude and longitude are optional: with them the Phius limit check runs, without them it reads Not checked, entered by hand. The same editor opens for Edit Values on an attached station.

c13.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-17 · Journey 5, the design temperatures
Two fields typed in the pane, each saved as it is committed, with an optional source note the Export report repeats. In °F or °C by the unit toggle. The card reads Not set, Incomplete (one of two) or Set. A heating value at or above the cooling value warns and still saves. They stay in the Model for the blended heat pump; nothing is written to METr in the first version.

c14.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-17 · Journey 6, a folder not found
A folder that cannot be found keeps its setting: it may be on a drive that is not connected. Its row says Folder not found and offers Locate and Remove. PH-Composer never removes a setting itself. Its stations are left out of the picker until it is found.

c15.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-17 · Journey 7, an edited station
The Model keeps the values as read from the file beside the edited ones. Edited cells are marked, the Export report lists them, and Restore Original Values works on any computer. Wind speed never counts as an edit, and a hand-entered climate has no edited mark. Edit Values opens the grid of board 12.

c16.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-17 · Journey 7, Replace
The picker shows the current and the new station side by side: dataset, distance, elevation difference and verdict, and a line when edited values will be lost. Attach becomes Replace; it is one Undo step. Clear removes the climate in one Undo step with no confirm; the site and the design temperatures stay.

c17.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-17 · Journey 7, a changed source file
A quiet Source changed mark and an Update from File action, which is Replace with the same station. Nothing updates on its own.
A site change: the verdict is never stored; it is worked out from the site and the station each time. Set Location shows the attached station and its ring and says before Set when the change would make it fail. Not drawn.

c18.text:
SETTLED 2026-11-17 · Journey 8, export
The report's climate section: site, dataset and station, the limit check, edited values, peak loads, wind speed and the design temperatures. This board shows its content, not the Export tab's layout.
Cooling 2 repeats Cooling 1 at export, as honeybee-ph's Grasshopper Phius-file component does; left alone honeybee-ph would write 0 °C and zero radiation. An unset climate zone exports as Not defined and an unset UTC offset as empty, each with a finding. An edited station and a hand-entered climate export as user-defined; an unedited station as Phius-approved. The station's coordinates and the edits travel in the provenance's assumptions. No folder location is written anywhere.

c19.text: Journey 3: a station outside the limits stays attached and says so on the card, the pane and in the Export report. Nothing is blocked.

c20.text: Journey 4: a hand-entered climate saved with gaps. The card and pane read Incomplete, the pane lists what is missing, and with no coordinates the limit check reads Not checked. Export leaves it out until it is complete.

c21.text: Journey 7: Set Location shows the attached station and its 50 mile ring. Moving the site outside it warns before Set; the station stays attached and then reads Fail.

c22.text:
PROVISIONAL · waits on a host measurement
Read from SketchUp Geolocation on a Model with no geolocation. Drawn as unavailable with the reason beside it. Whether PH-Composer can tell such a Model apart is still to be measured in SketchUp.

c23.text:
OPEN for planning · the panel's smallest size
At 360 px nine tabs wrap and take much of the height, so little of the pane shows. The tab row at this width is the shell's question, not Climate's; the pane itself scrolls.
